name: qkd_kv_grp_ctl

pin_regs.reason: two clock domains (ck / hck): synthesis pin registers take one clock. Every output is flop-driven in the RTL (boot_cdc sink_*/applied/fault, phase *_h/fault/idle, drain drained/fault); phase and drain inputs land on capture flops (go_q / meta_q, idle_meta / fault_meta / *_q); boot cfg_* enters the FIFO storage flops and the write-pointer logic (boot-only path). A wrapper edge on the phase inputs would move the compiled HBM launch edge.

purpose: KVJ-D 2026-10-17 (kv_static_join_plan item 7): per-group control tile x32, hardened once: qkd_static_kv_phase_launch + qkd_static_kv_drain_guard4 + 5 qkd_static_kv_boot_cdc (cdc0 front calendar HAS_SEAL0, cdc1..4 pc_path calendars HAS_SEAL1): every core->HBM crossing of one landing group, beside its landing seg / front calendar. Wires-only wrapper of unchanged ROLES RTL, 0 added edges.
